import itertools

    ne=[regions[i] for i in range(len(regions)) if mask>>i&1]

assert s[:5]==[3,6,9,18,21]
assert s==[3,6,9,18,21,42]
o={'A':42,'B':40,'C':63,'D':24}
assert s[-1]==o['A']
assert all(s[-1]!=v for k,v in o.items() if k!='A')

import math
def f(x):
    reps=[(a,b) for a in range(1,int(math.isqrt(x))+1) for b in range(1,a+1) if a*a+b*b==x]
    a,b=reps[0]
    return (a+1)**2+b*b
assert f(40)==53 and f(8)==13
opts={'A':84,'B':85,'C':83,'D':73}
assert f(68)==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert f(68)!=opts[k]

import math
def f(x):
    r=math.isqrt(x-4); assert r*r==x-4
    return (r+1)**2+4
assert f(40)==53 and f(8)==13
o={'A':84,'B':85,'C':83,'D':73}
assert f(68)==o['B']
assert all(f(68)!=v for k,v in o.items() if k!='B')
